_about: v2 checks. Every geometric v1 review issue has a row here; the id in each 'why' points into ../renders/attempt-N/review.md (A1-#n, A2-#n, A3-Xn). Object names follow DESIGN_LOG.md 'v2 naming'. distances.a/b are exact names. Attempt 2: rows tagged v2-A1-NN close issues from ../renders/attempt-1/review.md. PIV_hood values in rows: +1.315 = gap 5.3 (printed min-gap stop, HOOD_HI), -0.558 = gap 7.0 (thumbwheel stop-sleeve static max); keep them in sync with params.solve_eps if NIP_SET changes. Attempt 3: rows tagged v2-A2-NN close issues from ../renders/attempt-2/review.md. NEW PIV_hood values: +0.327 = gap 6.2 (HOOD_GAP_MIN raised 5.3 -> 6.2 for A2-01, printed min-gap stop, HOOD_HI), -0.558 = gap 7.0 (static max, unchanged); PIV_nip_lift -1.493 = the leaf stack goes solid against the cover roof (LEAF_PAD_H + LEAF_T = 4.5 between thumbwheel and roof). Nip rays are framed in PIV_hood (A2-04: the PIV_tilt-framed y37 ray slipped past the hood lip at full lift). Attempt 4: rows tagged v2-A3-NN close issues from ../renders/attempt-3/review.md. NEW PIV_nip_lift limit -2.190 = leaf solid with LEAF_TRAVEL 2.2 (A3 1.5 -> -1.493); LEAF_T 2.5 -> 2.3, so thumbwheel top to cover roof along the stud axis is 6.5 at rest and LEAF_PAD_H + LEAF_T = 4.3 solid; PIV_hood range unchanged at the static settings (+0.327 = gap 6.2, -0.558 = gap 7.0), HOOD_LO = -2.748. POCKET_D 13.9 -> 13.75 (payload_fit rows). CAB_encoder lead_len is the launcher-side budget of the one-piece 550 encoder lead: 550 - CAB_launcher_bundle - CAB_launcher_base path - 5 spare (params ENC_LEAD, finish.py writes it; about 115 at A3 path lengths). Attempt 5: rows tagged v2-A4-NN close issues from ../renders/attempt-4/review.md. PIV_gate is a prismatic joint (0 closed .. 52 open notch, stops -0.4 / 52.35). cable_junctions_ok CAB_bus_* (finish step): the three Hiwonder bus leads (a parallel 3-wire bus) end in one 3-way bus junction on the pan axis at (0, 0, 76), inside the hub bore (BOM item 14a); the CAB_bus_* x CAB_launcher_* pairs there are different conductors drawn to the same axis point. CAB_launcher_bundle -> CAB_launcher_base is one wire per conductor (cable_chains: encoder signal, phase conductors).
